title: A secret value exists only inside an input or behind a copy button
symptom: The value does not appear in web text
cause: The value is only in input.value or behind a copy button
fix: launch_cli.py web value --selector <selector> --save-env NAME (saves without printing the value)
For a copy button, click it, then web clipboard --save-env NAME
Do not OCR a value shown on screen (I/l confusion)
